summary: Madison‑Oneida BOCES urges the FCC to preserve the core E‑Rate program, maintain broad eligibility (including special construction and dark fiber), keep discount methodology locally responsive, keep CIPA requirements practical and respectful of privacy, and avoid federal screen‑time limits. Madison‑Oneida BOCES urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate’s core strengths, avoid one‑size‑fits‑all screen‑time limits, and prevent changes that would reduce access, increase administrative burden, or limit local flexibility. They also support simplification and fraud prevention measures.
